verdict: Service in the window is significantly worse than the baseline on lateness_sec, late_share, bunching_share.

evidence: [R] 98% of late trains were already late at Union St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Whitehall St-South Ferry: 104, at Union St: 8, at Jay St-MetroTech: 3, at Court St: 2.
[R] 91% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Union St.

[N] 100% of late trains were already late at Union St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Whitehall St-South Ferry: 90, at or before DeKalb Av: 9, at Jay St-MetroTech: 2, at Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr: 1. Largest time loss on segment Union St -> target (median +40s vs schedule).
[N] 81% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Union St.

[D] 98% of late trains were already late at Union St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before W 4 St-Wash Sq: 95, at DeKalb Av: 2, on approach from Union St: 2, at Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr: 1. Largest time loss on segment Grand St -> DeKalb Av (median +60s vs schedule).
[D] 88% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Union St.
[N] 67% of late trains were already late leaving Astoria-Ditmars Blvd: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
[D] 87% of late trains were already late leaving Norwood-205 St: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
[D] 100% of the run-time loss sits on one segment (Grand St -> DeKalb Av, median +60s): a signal timer, speed restriction, or failure on that segment.
33% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 1.9x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 23% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
[R] Trains that would arrive at DeKalb Av within 180s behind a D/N/W train lose 218s more there than others (p=0.000; 9% of trips affected); 16% of problem arrivals at the target had such a conflict.

[D] Trains that would arrive at Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr within 180s behind a R/N/W train lose 51s more there than others (p=0.019; 25% of trips affected); 24% of problem arrivals at the target had such a conflict.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 215s on average vs 124s otherwise (1.7x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 40% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.1x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 20% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Forest Hills-71 Av during the affected hours: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Inspect Grand St -> DeKalb Av for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr, where R, N, W trains run ahead of D trains bound for 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for R, N, D, W; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for R, N, D, W; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so R, N, W and D slots are offset by at least half a headway at Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
